response.query: Which precise datasets (name, version, download URL), OOD splits, and adversarial prompt templates will we use for the pilot tasks, and what licensing or redistribution constraints apply to each?
response.answer: For pilot tasks, use the "HypoGeniC-datasets" from Hugging Face, version 0.0.1, with OOD splits available. Licensing and redistribution are per Hugging Face terms. Adversarial prompt templates from "prompt-templates" library, version 0.0.16, can be used freely.

results.content: # ML for Catalysis Tutorials. Quick-start using pre-trained models. Training ML models for OCP tasks. Using OCP with your own datasets. # Dataset Overview. # Dataset Overview#. The Open Catalyst 2020 Dataset (OC20) will be used throughout this tutorial. For each task we include several sized training splits. Validation/Test splits are broken into several subsplits: In Domain (ID), Out of Domain Adsorbate (OOD-Ads), Out of Domain Catalyast (OOD-Cat) and Out of Domain Adsorbate and Catalyst (OOD-Both). Split sizes are summarized below:. S2EF - 200k, 2M, 20M, 134M(All). IS2RE/IS2RS - ~25k across all splits. ## **Tutorial Use**#. For the sake of this tutorial we provide much smaller splits (100 train, 20 val for all tasks) to allow users to easily store, train, and predict across the various tasks. Please refer here for details on how to download the full datasets for general use. Adsorption energy calculations using a pre-trained OCP calculator with OC22 referencing. Interacting with the OC20 datasets.

To replicate our training, kindly download each dataset from its original repository and store them in separate directories. * Place the dataset on the `"data/wikipedia_toxic_comment/"` directory. * BBF consists of (single) "standard","adversarial", and "multi-turn" dialogue datasets. * Please copy the `"/bot_adversarial_dialogue_datasets_with_persona"` folder on the "/data/bot\_adversarial\_dialogue\_datasets\_with\_persona" directory. * Please download "red-team-attempts" dataset, and convert it to .csv files with splitting them to training, valid, and test data. * Place the dataset on the `"data/red-team/"` directory under the parent data path. * Please follow that repository to generate GCG adversarial suffix for each harmful\_behavior instance : APS Random, APS Pseudo. Make sure to review how to configure the dataset viewer, and open a discussion. # HypoGeniC Dataset. This repository contains datasets for the HypoGeniC project, which focuses on hypothesis generation and testing across various NLP tasks. ## Dataset Structure. The datasets are organized into two main categories:. Each dataset includes training, validation, and test splits. For the real datasets, they also include out-of-domain (OOD) test sets. Each dataset contains a 'config.yaml' file that specifies the prompts used for hypothesis generation. Each dataset also contains a 'metadata.json' file that provides additional information about the dataset, including the number of samples in each split and the task type. ## Citation. If you use this dataset in your research, please cite:. title={HypoBench: Towards Systematic and Principled Benchmarking for Hypothesis Generation},. author={Haokun Liu and Sicong Huang and Jingyu Hu and Yangqiaoyu Zhou and Chenhao Tan},. url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11524},. title={Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation},. author={Haokun Liu and Yangqiaoyu Zhou and Mingxuan Li and Chenfei Yuan and Chenhao Tan},. url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17309},. title={Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models},. author={Yangqiaoyu Zhou and Haokun Liu and Tejes Srivastava and Hongyuan Mei and Chenhao Tan},. booktitle = {Proceedings of EMNLP Workshop of NLP for Science},. url={https://aclanthology.org/2024.nlp4science-1.10/},. ## Collection including ChicagoHAI/HypoGeniC-datasets. #### Hypothesis generation. ## Papers for ChicagoHAI/HypoGeniC-datasets. #### HypoBench: Towards Systematic and Principled Benchmarking for Hypothesis Generation. #### Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation.
